        original=self.view.data['config']['scope_ref'];self.view.data['config']['scope_ref']='project:captured-corruption'

            # Direct kernel observation bypasses API source-selection policy so the
            # actual selected source guard can invalidate and dispose this resource.

            self.assertEqual(result['posture'],'indeterminate');self.assertTrue(resource.closed);self.assertEqual(resource.memory,[])
        finally:self.view.data['config']['scope_ref']=original

def test_27_actual_expiry_timer_disposes(self):
        c=self.opening();c['message']['budget']['deadline']=(now()+timedelta(seconds=70)).isoformat();r=self.success(c);self.assertEqual(r['posture'],'active')
        resource=self.service.sessions.live[r['session_ref']];resource.note(b'private-note-expiring-in-real-time');held=resource.memory[0]
        deadline=time.monotonic()+90
        while not resource.closed and time.monotonic()<deadline:time.sleep(0.2)
        self.assertTrue(resource.closed,'real deadline disposal timer did not finish');self.assertEqual(held,bytearray(len(held)))
        self.assertEqual(self.success(self.inspection(r['session_ref']))['posture'],'expired')

def test_01_three_carriers_have_separate_typed_reference_evidence(self):
        service,proposal,_=self.submitted();manifest=copy.deepcopy(service.vault.manifest)
        reply=self.invoke(service,self.call(service,proposal));self.assertEqual(reply['kind'],'result',reply)
        report=reply['message'];self.assertEqual(report['result'],'pass',report)
        self.assertEqual(report['gaps'],[])
        selected=[c for c in report['checks'] if c['check_ref'].startswith('check:selected-carrier-reference-')]
        self.assertEqual(len(selected),3)
        classes=set()
        for check in selected:
            self.assertEqual(check['result'],'pass')
            detail=P.frame_parse(service.vault.object_read(check['evidence_bindings'][0]))['details']
            self.assertTrue(detail['reference_closure_only'])
            self.assertFalse(detail['current_owner_authority_verified'])
            self.assertFalse(detail['canonical_admission_granted'])
            classes.update(row['reference_class'] for row in detail['typed_references'])
        self.assertIn('signed-artifact-revision',classes)
        self.assertIn('operational-validation-receipt',classes)
        self.assertIn('bound-original-document',classes)
        self.assertIn('declared-workflow-type-reference',classes)
        prepared=self.invoke(service,self.call(service,proposal,'change.prepare'))
        self.assertEqual(prepared['kind'],'result',prepared)
        self.assertEqual(len(prepared['message']['stable_core_bindings']),5)
        self.assertEqual(len(prepared['message']['gaps']),1)
        self.assertEqual(prepared['message']['posture'],'blocked')
        self.assertEqual(service.vault.manifest,manifest)
        self.assertEqual(P.compact(self.view.data['projection']),self.projection)

def test_02_substituted_original_source_refused_before_claim(self):
        service,proposal,_=self.submitted()
        challenge=P.frame_parse(service.vault.object_read(service.channel.policy['challenge_control']['routing_binding']))
        row=next(r for r in challenge['accepted_evidence'] if r['kind']=='source')
        selected=service.vault.inputs[row['binding']['ref']]
        path=service.vault.root/selected['path'];path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes()+b' ')
        before=self.journal(service);reply=self.invoke(service,self.call(service,proposal))
        self.assertEqual(reply['schema_version'],'lab-api-transport-error/v1-candidate')
        self.assertEqual(reply['code'],'unauthenticated-channel')
        self.assertEqual(self.journal(service),before)

def test_01_actual_challenge_proposal_preserves_exact_revision_and_original_bytes(self):
        service,request,witness=self.example();reply=self.invoke(service,request());self.assertEqual(reply['kind'],'result',reply)
        proposal=reply['message'];self.assertEqual(len(proposal['targets']),4)
        target=next(t for t in proposal['targets'] if t['artifact']['carrier_ref']=='cal.artifact-type.challenge-event/v1');raw=service.vault.object_read({'ref':target['content']['content_ref'],'sha256':target['content']['byte_sha256']})
        self.assertEqual(raw,witness['candidate_original']);self.assertNotEqual(raw,self.view.handle.common.encoded(P.frame_parse(raw)))
        body=P.frame_parse(raw);self.assertEqual(body['payload']['subject_version_ref'],witness['subject']['version_ref'])
        self.assertEqual(body['payload']['response_state'],'open');self.assertEqual(body['payload']['resolution_decision_ref'],'none')
        connections=proposal['connection_proposals'];self.assertEqual(len(connections),2)
        self.assertEqual({c['relation_kind_ref'] for c in connections},{'relation.member-of','relation.challenges'})
        evidence=next(t for t in proposal['targets'] if t['artifact']['carrier_ref']=='cal.artifact-type.evidence-set/v1')
        evidence_raw=service.vault.object_read({'ref':evidence['content']['content_ref'],'sha256':evidence['content']['byte_sha256']})
        evidence_body=P.frame_parse(evidence_raw);self.assertEqual(evidence_body['lifecycle_state'],'candidate')
        self.assertEqual(evidence_body['relation_refs'][0]['counterpart_ref'],witness['routing']['evidence_project']['version_ref'])
        relations=[t for t in proposal['targets'] if t['artifact']['carrier_ref'].startswith('cal.artifact-type.typed-relation/')]
        self.assertEqual(len(relations),2)
        for connection in connections:
            matching=[]
            for t in relations:
                r=P.frame_parse(service.vault.object_read({'ref':t['content']['content_ref'],'sha256':t['content']['byte_sha256']}))
                if r['payload']['relation_kind_ref']==connection['relation_kind_ref']:matching.append(r)
            self.assertEqual(len(matching),1);self.assertEqual(matching[0]['payload']['qualifiers'],connection['qualifiers'])
            for end in ('source','target'):
                self.assertEqual(matching[0]['payload'][end]['version_ref'],connection[end]['artifact']['version_ref'])
        self.assertEqual(P.compact(self.view.data['projection']),self.projection)
        self.assertEqual(self.inspect(service)['kind'],'result')

            from . import example_fixture as F

            bridge=service.sessions.bridge

def test_06_complete_SQL_original_body_BLOBs(self):
        from .projection import Generation,DATA_TABLES
        generation=Generation(self.view,cut(self.view),self.schemas);self.addCleanup(generation.close)
        self.assertEqual(generation.db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM artifact_revision').fetchone()[0],len(self.view.subjects))
        self.assertEqual(generation.metadata[2],self.view.handle.manifest['profile_binding']['sha256'])
        for s in self.view.subjects.values():
            if s['source'].get('encoding')!=self.view.handle.custody.ENCODING:continue
            h=model.artifact_ref(self.view,s);raw=model.record_bytes(self.view,s)[0]
            self.assertEqual(generation.db.execute('SELECT content FROM content_cache WHERE byte_sha256=?',(h['byte_sha256'],)).fetchone()[0],raw)
        self.assertEqual(generation.db.execute('SELECT stream_ref,cursor,head_sha256 FROM stream_watermark ORDER BY stream_ref').fetchall(),[(s['stream_ref'],s['cursor'],s['head_sha256']) for s in sorted(cut(self.view)['streams'],key=lambda s:s['stream_ref'])])
        self.assertEqual(generation.db.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchall(),[('ok',)]);self.assertEqual(generation.db.execute('PRAGMA foreign_key_check').fetchall(),[])
        self.assertEqual(set(DATA_TABLES),{'stream_watermark','content_cache','artifact_revision','artifact_head','typed_relation_projection','contract_binding_projection','reference_resolution','authority_fact_projection','ontology_representation_link','projection_gap'})

def test_13_actual_stdout_nonce_authenticated_status(self):
        process=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,str(HERE/'serve.py'),'--source-sha256',source.sha((HERE/'source-manifest.json').read_bytes()),'--policy',str(self.policy),'--policy-sha256',self.pin,'--protocol-profile-sha256',PROFILE],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        try:
            challenge=source.parse(process.stdout.readline());process.stdin.write(proof(self.key,challenge)+b'\n');process.stdin.flush()
            authenticated=source.parse(process.stdout.readline());self.assertEqual(authenticated['schema_version'],'lab-local-reader-authenticated/v1-candidate')
            c=call(authenticated['context'],'lab.status',cut(self.view));process.stdin.write(compact(c)+b'\n');process.stdin.flush()
            result=source.parse(process.stdout.readline());self.assertTrue(self.schemas.valid('api-reply',result),result);self.assertEqual(result['kind'],'result',result)
            self.assertEqual(result['message']['supported_operations'],list(SUPPORTED));self.assertEqual(result['message']['source_cut'],self.view.custody_signed_sources.source_cut)
            process.stdin.close();process.wait(timeout=60);self.assertEqual(process.returncode,0,process.stderr.read())
        finally:
            if process.poll() is None:process.kill();process.wait()

def test_00_all_eleven_actual_operations(self):
        for op in ['lab.status','catalog.get','artifact.query']:
            r=self.success(call(self.channel.context,op,cut(self.view)))
            if op=='lab.status':self.assertEqual(r['supported_operations'],list(SUPPORTED))
        s=next(s for s in self.view.subjects.values() if s['identity']==R.WORK)
        from .artifact_model import artifact_ref
        self.success(call(self.channel.context,'artifact.inspect',cut(self.view),artifact=artifact_ref(self.view,s),include=['body','contract','gaps']))
        self.success(candidate_call(self.service,self.target,'change.prepare','fixture:prepare'))
        self.success(candidate_call(self.service,self.target,'change.validate','validate:integrated'))
        self.success(call(self.channel.context,'operation.inspect',None,lookup={'operation':'change.prepare','idempotency_key':'fixture:prepare'}))
        self.success(self.refreshing());self.fresh_delivery();r,c=self.opening_success();self.success(self.inspection(r['session_ref']));closed=self.success(self.closing(r));self.assertTrue(closed['discarded_memory'])
        observed={x['reply']['operation'] for x in self.events if x['reply']['kind']=='result'};self.assertEqual(observed,set(LEGACY_SUPPORTED))

def test_24_captured_source_corruption_disposes_on_inspection(self):
        r,c=self.opening_success();resource=self.service.sessions.live[r['session_ref']];resource.note(b'owned-fixture-source-invalidation')
        original=self.view.data['config']['scope_ref'];self.view.data['config']['scope_ref']='project:captured-corruption'
        try:
            # Direct kernel observation bypasses API source-selection policy so the
            # actual selected source guard can invalidate and dispose this resource.
            result=self.service.sessions.inspect(self.inspection(r['session_ref'])['message'],{'ref':'fixture','sha256':'0'*64},self.service.sessions.selected(r['session_ref'])['source_cut'])
            self.assertEqual(result['posture'],'indeterminate');self.assertTrue(resource.closed);self.assertEqual(resource.memory,[])
        finally:self.view.data['config']['scope_ref']=original

def test_27_actual_expiry_timer_disposes(self):
        c=self.opening();c['message']['budget']['deadline']=(now()+timedelta(seconds=70)).isoformat();r=self.success(c);self.assertEqual(r['posture'],'active')
        resource=self.service.sessions.live[r['session_ref']];resource.note(b'private-note-expiring-in-real-time');held=resource.memory[0]
        deadline=time.monotonic()+90
        while not resource.closed and time.monotonic()<deadline:time.sleep(0.2)
        self.assertTrue(resource.closed,'real deadline disposal timer did not finish');self.assertEqual(held,bytearray(len(held)))
        self.assertEqual(self.success(self.inspection(r['session_ref']))['posture'],'expired')

def test_actual_original_byte_export(self):
        result = self.host.materialize(self.request)
        self.assertEqual(result['posture'], 'published')
        generation = self.root / sha(encoded(self.request))
        for path, material in zip(self.request['managed_relative_paths'], self.actual, strict=True):
            self.assertEqual((generation / 'files' / path).read_bytes(), material.original_bytes)
        self.assertFalse(result['canonical_replay_source'])
        self.assertEqual(result['authority_effect'], 'none')
        self.observations.append({'request': copy.deepcopy(self.request), 'result': result, 'manifest': json.loads((generation / 'manifest.json').read_bytes()), 'owned_root': str(self.root), 'fixture_permission_only': True})

def test_05_metadata_eight_operation_grant_cannot_export(self):
        call = self.call()
        self.service.close()
        # A metadata grant receives its own fresh workspace. Export generations
        # and directory scope remain protected by the original export grant.
        separate = Path(self.enterContext(tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cal-R03-export-denied-metadata-')))
        separate.chmod(0o700)
        self.key,self.policy,self.pin = MF.provision(separate,{}, {}, scoped=False)
        self.start()
        call['caller_context_ref'] = self.channel.context['context_ref']
        reply = self.invoke(call)
        self.assertEqual(reply['code'], 'unsupported-operation')
        self.assertEqual(list((self.root / 'workspace/journal').glob('*')), [])
        self.assertEqual(list((separate / 'workspace/journal').glob('*')), [])

def test_20_stdio_actual_nonce_and_export(self):
        self.service.close()
        process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,str(HERE/'serve.py'),'--policy',str(self.policy),'--policy-sha256',self.pin,'--source-sha256',SOURCE,'--protocol-profile-sha256',PROFILE], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        try:
            challenge = source.parse(process.stdout.readline())
            process.stdin.write(MF.proof(self.key, challenge) + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            auth = source.parse(process.stdout.readline())
            client = SimpleNamespace(channel=SimpleNamespace(context=auth['context'],policy=source.parse(self.policy.read_bytes())),schemas=self.schemas)
            call = F.call(client,self.selected,key='fixture:stdio-export')
            process.stdin.write(compact(call) + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            reply = source.parse(process.stdout.readline())
            self.assertEqual(reply['kind'], 'result', reply)
            self.assertEqual(reply['message']['posture'], 'published')
            self.events.append({'call': call,'reply':reply,'actual_stdio':True})
            self.public.append({'owned_root':str(self.root),'actual_stdio_challenge':challenge,'authentication_reply':auth,'authority_effect':'none'})
            process.stdin.close()
            code = process.wait(timeout=120)
            self.assertEqual(code,0,process.stderr.read().decode())
        finally:
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.kill()
                process.wait()
            for stream in (process.stdout,process.stderr):
                stream.close()

def test_22_kernel_refuses_root_swap_after_plan(self):
        call = self.call()
        request = call['message']
        materials = []
        with M.model_read_batch(self.view):
            for header in request['artifact_refs']:
                raw,locator,encoding,_ = M.record_bytes(self.view,self.view.subjects[header['version_ref']])
                materials.append(K.Material(compact(header),raw,locator,encoding))
        control = self.channel.policy['export_control']
        selected = K.Selection(request['selection_ref'],compact(request['source_cut']),tuple(materials),self.service.vault.material(control['privacy_review_binding']))
        root = self.output()
        calls = [0]
        def fixture_permission():
            calls[0] += 1
            if calls[0] == 2:
                root.rename(root.with_name('exports-original'))
                root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
            return True
        host = K.ExportHost(root,request['output_root_scope_ref'],request['actor'],selected,self.schemas,self.view.custody_signed_sources.guard,fixture_permission,1048576,control['output_root_identity'])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            host.materialize(request)
        self.assertEqual(list(root.iterdir()),[])
        self.assertTrue((root.with_name('exports-original')/'.scope.json').is_file())

def test_23_busy_quota_lock_retains_pending_key(self):
        descriptor = os.open(self.output()/'.generation.lock',os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
        try:
            fcntl.flock(descriptor,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            call = self.call()
            reply = self.invoke(call)
            self.assertEqual(reply['message']['code'],'recovery-required')
        finally:
            os.close(descriptor)
        query = MF.call(self.channel.context,'operation.inspect',cut(self.view),lookup={'operation':'files.materialize','idempotency_key':'fixture:public-export'})
        result = self.success(query)
        self.assertTrue(result['reconciliation_required'])
        self.assertEqual(result['posture'],'indeterminate')
        call['call_id'] = 'call:lock-retry:'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        reply = self.invoke(call)
        self.assertEqual(reply['message']['code'],'recovery-required')
        self.assertEqual({p.name for p in self.output().iterdir()},{'.scope.json','.generation.lock'})

        self.assertEqual(report['result'],'not-evaluable');self.assertEqual(report['authority_effect'],'none')

def test_all_original_facts_and_witnesses(self):
        with participation_snapshot(self.parent, self.delivery) as snapshot:
            self.assertIs(type(snapshot), self.delivery.EL.ExactSources)
            self.assertEqual(set(snapshot.records), set(self.parent.sources.records))
            for version, original in self.parent.sources.records.items():
                selected, body = snapshot.get(original.artifact)
                self.assertEqual(selected.original, original.original)
                self.assertEqual(selected.revision_witness, original.revision_witness)
                self.assertEqual(selected.artifact, original.artifact)
                self.assertEqual(body, self.delivery.EL.parse(original.original))

def test_11_release_review_preserves_actual_missing_human_and_full_qualification(self):
        h,c,p=self.example(release=True);root=Path(p['install']['root']);before={x.name for x in root.iterdir()};reply=self.invoke(h,c);self.assertEqual(reply['kind'],'result',reply);self.assertEqual(reply['message']['posture'],'blocked');subjects={g['subject_ref'] for g in reply['message']['gaps']};self.assertTrue({'AC01','AC12','AC13','human-pilot','api-qualification','review-closure'}<=subjects);self.assertEqual({x.name for x in root.iterdir()},before);self.assertFalse((root/'active.json').exists());record=P.source.parse(h.vault.object_read(reply['message']['validation_report_binding']));self.assertFalse(record['release_decision_created']);self.assertTrue(record['final_R08_decision_required']);self.assertFalse(record['whole_lab_release_approved']);self.assertFalse(record['installation_performed']);self.assertFalse(record['publication_performed'])

def test_19_actual_signature_requires_exact_bound_candidate_payload(self):
        import base64
        from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PrivateKey
        from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
        from cryptography.exceptions import InvalidSignature
        from .release_readiness import ReleaseReadiness
        key=Ed25519PrivateKey.generate();public=base64.b64encode(key.public_key().public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.Raw,serialization.PublicFormat.Raw)).decode();payload={'fixture_signature_check_only':True,'release_decision_created':False,'authority_effect':'none'};signature=base64.b64encode(key.sign(P.compact(payload))).decode()
        ReleaseReadiness.verify_signature(public,payload,signature)
        changed=copy.deepcopy(payload);changed['fixture_signature_check_only']=False
        with self.assertRaises(InvalidSignature):ReleaseReadiness.verify_signature(public,changed,signature)

def test_20_actual_private_custody_signature_grants_no_governing_role(self):
        import base64
        from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
        from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PrivateKey
        from .installation_release import InstallationRelease
        from .release_readiness import ReleaseReadiness
        h,c,p=self.example(release=True);builder=InstallationRelease(h,'release.prepare',F.now()+timedelta(minutes=60));readiness=ReleaseReadiness(builder,p['release']['readiness_contract_binding'])
        issuer=serialization.load_pem_private_key(W.read_private(h.vault.root.parent/'reader.pem'),password=None);key=Ed25519PrivateKey.generate();public=base64.b64encode(key.public_key().public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.Raw,serialization.PublicFormat.Raw)).decode()
        public_binding=h.vault.object(P.compact({'schema_version':'lab-release-reviewer-public-key/v1-candidate','principal_ref':'evidence-signer:bounded-fixture','public_key_b64':public,'authority_effect':'none'}))
        payload={'issuer_principal_ref':h.channel.context['principal_ref'],'signer_ref':'signer:bounded-evidence-only','principal_ref':'evidence-signer:bounded-fixture','public_key_binding':public_binding,'manifest_binding':p['release']['manifest_binding'],'source_cut':c['expected_source_cut'],'scope_refs':h.channel.context['scope_refs'],'allowed_kinds':['privacy'],'trusted_human_source_bindings':[],'not_before':(F.now()-timedelta(seconds=1)).isoformat(),'expires_at':(F.now()+timedelta(minutes=10)).isoformat(),'grant_effect':'candidate-evidence-authenticity-only','governing_role_granted':False,'owner_approval_granted':False,'authority_effect':'none'}
        def grant(payload):return h.vault.object(P.compact({'schema_version':'lab-private-evidence-custody-grant/v1-candidate','payload':payload,'signature_b64':base64.b64encode(issuer.sign(P.compact(payload))).decode(),'authority_effect':'none'}))
        selected={'signer_ref':payload['signer_ref'],'principal_ref':payload['principal_ref'],'public_key_binding':public_binding,'custody_grant_binding':grant(payload),'allowed_kinds':['privacy']}
        verified=readiness.custody(selected,p['release']['manifest_binding'],c['expected_source_cut']);self.assertFalse(verified['governing_role_granted']);self.assertFalse(verified['owner_approval_granted'])
        changed=copy.deepcopy(payload);changed['owner_approval_granted']=True;selected['custody_grant_binding']=grant(changed)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):readiness.custody(selected,p['release']['manifest_binding'],c['expected_source_cut'])

def test_02_all_seven_public_read_operations_with_actual_Actor(self):
        context,_=self.authenticated();current=cut(self.view)
        for op in ('lab.status','catalog.get','artifact.query'):
            self.assertEqual(self.machine_call(F.call(context,op,current))['kind'],'result')
        subject=next(s for s in self.view.subjects.values() if s['identity']==self.peer.resource.agent['payload']['profile_ref'].split('@')[0])
        self.assertEqual(self.machine_call(F.call(context,'artifact.inspect',current,artifact=M.artifact_ref(self.view,subject),include=['body','contract','gaps']))['kind'],'result')
        message=D.query(self.view.custody_signed_sources,self.peer.service.sessions.bridge)
        message['budget'].update(max_input_bytes=65536,max_output_bytes=1048576)
        request=F.call(context,'lab.status',current);request.update(operation='context.get',message=message)
        self.assertEqual(self.machine_call(request)['kind'],'result')
        request=self.inspection(context['session_ref'])
        request['caller_context_ref']=context['context_ref']
        request['message']['actor']={k:context[k] for k in ('principal_ref','agent_instance_ref','assignment_ref','session_ref')}
        request['message']['actor']['role_assignment_refs']=[]
        self.assertEqual(self.machine_call(request)['kind'],'result')
        self.assertEqual(self.machine_call(F.call(context,'operation.inspect',None,lookup={'operation':'session.open','idempotency_key':self.opening_call['idempotency_key']}))['kind'],'result')
        self.assertEqual({row['operation'] for row in self.machine_events},set(MT.READ_OPERATIONS))

def test_deadline_after_evidence_retains_completed_record(self):
        from . import service as module
        original=module.now;actual=self.service.candidates.validate;expired=[False]
        def validated(*args):
            result=actual(*args);expired[0]=True;return result
        c=candidate_call(self.service,self.target,'change.validate','validate:expired-after')
        with patch.object(self.service.candidates,'validate',side_effect=validated),patch.object(module,'now',side_effect=lambda:original()+timedelta(days=1) if expired[0] else original()):
            r=self.service.call(compact(c));self.assertEqual(r['message']['code'],'indeterminate',r)
        i=call(self.channel.context,'operation.inspect',None,lookup={'operation':'change.validate','idempotency_key':'validate:expired-after'})
        self.assertEqual(self.service.call(compact(i))['message']['posture'],'completed')

test_preparation.py:Preparation.test_sma.source_excerpt:
def test_small_receipt_budget_refused_before_effect(self):
        # The declared outer wire ceiling is >=4096. Below that bound,
        # refusal is a transport error, before a domain result or durable effect.
        # This matches the independently retained CorrectedPreparation case.
        c=candidate_call(self.service,self.target);c['max_response_bytes']=1
        r=self.service.call(compact(c))
        self.assertEqual(r['schema_version'],'lab-api-transport-error/v1-candidate')
        self.assertEqual(r['code'],'invalid-envelope')
        self.assertFalse(list((self.root/'workspace/journal').iterdir()))

def test_small_receipt_budget_refused_before_effect(self):
        # The exact wire contract requires >=4096. A ceiling of 1 is malformed
        # before dispatch; the domain budget gate is never reached.
        c=candidate_call(self.service,self.target);c['max_response_bytes']=1
        with patch.object(self.service.candidates,'prepare',side_effect=AssertionError('must not dispatch')):
            r=self.service.call(compact(c))
        self.assertEqual(r['schema_version'],'lab-api-transport-error/v1-candidate')
        self.assertEqual(r['code'],'invalid-envelope')
        self.assertFalse(list((self.root/'workspace/journal').iterdir()))

def test_00_actual_two_target_review_one_checkpoint(self):
        service, request, witness = self.example()
        reply = self.invoke(service, request())
        self.assertEqual(reply['kind'], 'result')
        result = reply['message']
        manifest = self.manifest(service, reply)
        self.assertEqual(result['human_checkpoint_count'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(result['atomicity_requirement'], 'all-or-nothing')
        self.assertEqual(len(result['ordered_core_bindings']), 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(manifest['targets']), 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(manifest['ordered_required_owner_responses']), 2)
        self.assertEqual(result['base_cut'], H.cut(self.view))
        self.assertTrue(result['all_targets_materialized'])
        self.assertFalse(manifest['current_owner_authority_verified'])
        self.assertIsNone(manifest['actual_owner_outcome'])
        self.assertEqual(manifest['repository_admissions_applied'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(manifest['runtime_activations'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(manifest['external_effect_refs'], [])
        for row in manifest['targets']:
            body = service.vault.material(row['original_content_binding'])
            self.assertEqual(P.source.sha(body), row['target']['artifact']['byte_sha256'])
            self.assertNotEqual(body, self.view.handle.common.encoded(P.frame_parse(body)))

def test_08_actual_nonce_and_operator_context(self):
        service, _, witness = self.example()
        from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PublicKey
        proof = witness['signed_nonce_proof']
        Ed25519PublicKey.from_public_bytes(base64.b64decode(witness['public_policy']['reader_public_key'])).verify(
            base64.b64decode(proof['signature']), P.compact(proof['challenge']))
        context = service.channel.context
        self.assertEqual(context['role_assignment_bindings'], [])
        self.assertEqual(context['authority_scope'], 'operator-local')
        for key in ['agent_instance_ref', 'session_ref', 'assignment_ref']:
            self.assertIsNone(context[key])
        self.assertFalse(context['accept_client_supplied_authority_context'])
        self.assertNotIn('session.open', service.channel.policy['allowed_operations'])
        self.assertNotIn('admission.apply', service.channel.policy['allowed_operations'])
        self.assertEqual(len(service.channel.policy['allowed_operations']), 9)

                self.channel.termination_guard()
        finally:

        self.assertEqual(self.channel.termination_basis, self.original_basis)
        self.channel.termination_guard()

def test_06_source_identity_is_not_Agent_authentication_or_extended_permission(self):
        selected = self.original_basis['period_binding']
        raw = (A.ROOT / selected['ref']).read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(source.sha(raw), selected['sha256'])
        period = source.parse(raw)
        self.assertEqual(period['expires_at'], '2026-10-13T01:28:58.791379+00:00')
        self.assertLessEqual(A.instant(self.channel.policy['expires_at']), A.instant(period['expires_at']))
        self.assertEqual(self.channel.policy['session_control']['max_session_seconds'], 900)
        self.assertEqual(self.channel.context['role_assignment_bindings'], [])
        for field in ('agent_instance_ref', 'assignment_ref', 'session_ref'):
            self.assertIsNone(self.channel.context[field])
        self.assertEqual(self.channel.termination_guard(), self.channel.context)

def test_01_actual_submit_prepare_review_retry_inspection(self):
        service, proposal, witness = self.submitted()
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(service.vault.manifest)
        inputs = copy.deepcopy(service.vault.inputs)
        reply = self.invoke(service, self.operation(service, 'change.prepare', proposal, 'fixture:composed-prepare'))
        self.assertEqual(reply['kind'], 'result', reply)
        review = reply['message']
        self.assertEqual(len(review['stable_core_bindings']), 5)
        self.assertTrue(review['gaps'])
        call = self.operation(service, 'proposal.review', review, 'fixture:composed-review')
        reply = self.invoke(service, call)
        self.assertEqual(reply['kind'], 'result', reply)
        package = reply['message']
        self.assertEqual(package['human_checkpoint_count'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(package['ordered_core_bindings'], review['stable_core_bindings'])
        self.assertTrue(package['all_targets_materialized'])
        material = P.frame_parse(service.vault.object_read(package['manifest_binding']))
        self.assertEqual(len(material['targets']), 5)
        self.assertEqual(len(material['ordered_required_owner_responses']), 10)
        self.assertEqual(material['original_semantic_and_operational_gaps'], review['gaps'])
        self.assertIsNone(material['actual_owner_outcome'])
        self.assertFalse(material['current_owner_authority_verified'])
        self.assertEqual(material['repository_admissions_applied'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(material['runtime_activations'], 0)
        W.privacy(material)
        before = self.journal(service)
        call['call_id'] += ':retry'
        retry = self.invoke(service, call)
        self.assertEqual(retry['message'], package)
        self.assertEqual(self.journal(service), before)
        inspect = F.call(service.channel.context, 'operation.inspect', H.cut(self.view))
        inspect['deadline'] = service.channel.context['expires_at']
        inspect['message']['lookup'] = {'operation': 'proposal.review', 'idempotency_key': 'fixture:composed-review'}
        self.assertEqual(self.invoke(service, inspect)['kind'], 'result')
        self.assertEqual(service.vault.manifest, manifest)
        self.assertEqual(service.vault.inputs, inputs)
        self.assertEqual(P.compact(self.view.data['projection']), self.projection)

def test_24_captured_source_corruption_disposes_on_inspection(self):
        r,c=self.opening_success();resource=self.service.sessions.live[r['session_ref']];resource.note(b'owned-fixture-source-invalidation')
        original=self.view.data['config']['scope_ref'];self.view.data['config']['scope_ref']='project:captured-corruption'
        try:
            # Direct kernel observation bypasses API source-selection policy so the
            # actual selected source guard can invalidate and dispose this resource.
            result=self.service.sessions.inspect(self.inspection(r['session_ref'])['message'],{'ref':'fixture','sha256':'0'*64},self.service.sessions.selected(r['session_ref'])['source_cut'])
            self.assertEqual(result['posture'],'indeterminate');self.assertTrue(resource.closed);self.assertEqual(resource.memory,[])
        finally:self.view.data['config']['scope_ref']=original

def test_27_actual_expiry_timer_disposes(self):
        c=self.opening();c['message']['budget']['deadline']=(now()+timedelta(seconds=70)).isoformat();r=self.success(c);self.assertEqual(r['posture'],'active')
        resource=self.service.sessions.live[r['session_ref']];resource.note(b'private-note-expiring-in-real-time');held=resource.memory[0]
        deadline=time.monotonic()+90
        while not resource.closed and time.monotonic()<deadline:time.sleep(0.2)
        self.assertTrue(resource.closed,'real deadline disposal timer did not finish');self.assertEqual(held,bytearray(len(held)))
        self.assertEqual(self.success(self.inspection(r['session_ref']))['posture'],'expired')

def test_01_three_carriers_have_separate_typed_reference_evidence(self):
        service,proposal,_=self.submitted();manifest=copy.deepcopy(service.vault.manifest)
        reply=self.invoke(service,self.call(service,proposal));self.assertEqual(reply['kind'],'result',reply)
        report=reply['message'];self.assertEqual(report['result'],'pass',report)
        self.assertEqual(report['gaps'],[])
        selected=[c for c in report['checks'] if c['check_ref'].startswith('check:selected-carrier-reference-')]
        self.assertEqual(len(selected),3)
        classes=set()
        for check in selected:
            self.assertEqual(check['result'],'pass')
            detail=P.frame_parse(service.vault.object_read(check['evidence_bindings'][0]))['details']
            self.assertTrue(detail['reference_closure_only'])
            self.assertFalse(detail['current_owner_authority_verified'])
            self.assertFalse(detail['canonical_admission_granted'])
            classes.update(row['reference_class'] for row in detail['typed_references'])
        self.assertIn('signed-artifact-revision',classes)
        self.assertIn('operational-validation-receipt',classes)
        self.assertIn('bound-original-document',classes)
        self.assertIn('declared-workflow-type-reference',classes)
        prepared=self.invoke(service,self.call(service,proposal,'change.prepare'))
        self.assertEqual(prepared['kind'],'result',prepared)
        self.assertEqual(len(prepared['message']['stable_core_bindings']),5)
        self.assertEqual(len(prepared['message']['gaps']),1)
        self.assertEqual(prepared['message']['posture'],'blocked')
        self.assertEqual(service.vault.manifest,manifest)
        self.assertEqual(P.compact(self.view.data['projection']),self.projection)

def test_02_substituted_original_source_refused_before_claim(self):
        service,proposal,_=self.submitted()
        challenge=P.frame_parse(service.vault.object_read(service.channel.policy['challenge_control']['routing_binding']))
        row=next(r for r in challenge['accepted_evidence'] if r['kind']=='source')
        selected=service.vault.inputs[row['binding']['ref']]
        path=service.vault.root/selected['path'];path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes()+b' ')
        before=self.journal(service);reply=self.invoke(service,self.call(service,proposal))
        self.assertEqual(reply['schema_version'],'lab-api-transport-error/v1-candidate')
        self.assertEqual(reply['code'],'unauthenticated-channel')
        self.assertEqual(self.journal(service),before)

def test_01_actual_challenge_proposal_preserves_exact_revision_and_original_bytes(self):
        service,request,witness=self.example();reply=self.invoke(service,request());self.assertEqual(reply['kind'],'result',reply)
        proposal=reply['message'];self.assertEqual(len(proposal['targets']),4)
        target=next(t for t in proposal['targets'] if t['artifact']['carrier_ref']=='cal.artifact-type.challenge-event/v1');raw=service.vault.object_read({'ref':target['content']['content_ref'],'sha256':target['content']['byte_sha256']})
        self.assertEqual(raw,witness['candidate_original']);self.assertNotEqual(raw,self.view.handle.common.encoded(P.frame_parse(raw)))
        body=P.frame_parse(raw);self.assertEqual(body['payload']['subject_version_ref'],witness['subject']['version_ref'])
        self.assertEqual(body['payload']['response_state'],'open');self.assertEqual(body['payload']['resolution_decision_ref'],'none')
        connections=proposal['connection_proposals'];self.assertEqual(len(connections),2)
        self.assertEqual({c['relation_kind_ref'] for c in connections},{'relation.member-of','relation.challenges'})
        evidence=next(t for t in proposal['targets'] if t['artifact']['carrier_ref']=='cal.artifact-type.evidence-set/v1')
        evidence_raw=service.vault.object_read({'ref':evidence['content']['content_ref'],'sha256':evidence['content']['byte_sha256']})
        evidence_body=P.frame_parse(evidence_raw);self.assertEqual(evidence_body['lifecycle_state'],'candidate')
        self.assertEqual(evidence_body['relation_refs'][0]['counterpart_ref'],witness['routing']['evidence_project']['version_ref'])
        relations=[t for t in proposal['targets'] if t['artifact']['carrier_ref'].startswith('cal.artifact-type.typed-relation/')]
        self.assertEqual(len(relations),2)
        for connection in connections:
            matching=[]
            for t in relations:
                r=P.frame_parse(service.vault.object_read({'ref':t['content']['content_ref'],'sha256':t['content']['byte_sha256']}))
                if r['payload']['relation_kind_ref']==connection['relation_kind_ref']:matching.append(r)
            self.assertEqual(len(matching),1);self.assertEqual(matching[0]['payload']['qualifiers'],connection['qualifiers'])
            for end in ('source','target'):
                self.assertEqual(matching[0]['payload'][end]['version_ref'],connection[end]['artifact']['version_ref'])
        self.assertEqual(P.compact(self.view.data['projection']),self.projection)
        self.assertEqual(self.inspect(service)['kind'],'result')

def test_03_exact_retry_does_not_redispatch(self):
        host, request, _ = self.example()
        first = self.invoke(host, request)
        self.assertEqual(first['kind'], 'result', first)
        before = self.journal(host)
        request['call_id'] = 'call:classification:retry:' + uuid.uuid4().hex
        second = self.invoke(host, request)
        self.assertEqual(second['kind'], 'result', second)
        self.assertEqual(second['message'], first['message'])
        self.assertEqual(self.journal(host), before)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.rules(host)), 1)
        self.assert_live(host, request)

def test_11_actual_source_corruption_refused_before_release(self):
        with scoped_service(self.schemas) as (view,channel,service,path):
            bridge=service.sessions.bridge;original=view.data['config']['scope_ref']
            try:
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    with D.FACT_SCOPE.read_scope(view.custody_signed_sources,D.EL,bridge,producer=D,
                                                package_checks=[(D.verify_source,bridge.delivery_pin)]) as facts:
                        view.data['config']['scope_ref']='project:owned-scope-corruption'
                        row=next(iter(facts.records.values()));facts.get(row.artifact)

def test_06_complete_SQL_original_body_BLOBs(self):
        from .projection import Generation,DATA_TABLES
        generation=Generation(self.view,cut(self.view),self.schemas);self.addCleanup(generation.close)
        self.assertEqual(generation.db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM artifact_revision').fetchone()[0],len(self.view.subjects))
        self.assertEqual(generation.metadata[2],self.view.handle.manifest['profile_binding']['sha256'])
        for s in self.view.subjects.values():
            if s['source'].get('encoding')!=self.view.handle.custody.ENCODING:continue
            h=model.artifact_ref(self.view,s);raw=model.record_bytes(self.view,s)[0]
            self.assertEqual(generation.db.execute('SELECT content FROM content_cache WHERE byte_sha256=?',(h['byte_sha256'],)).fetchone()[0],raw)
        self.assertEqual(generation.db.execute('SELECT stream_ref,cursor,head_sha256 FROM stream_watermark ORDER BY stream_ref').fetchall(),[(s['stream_ref'],s['cursor'],s['head_sha256']) for s in sorted(cut(self.view)['streams'],key=lambda s:s['stream_ref'])])
        self.assertEqual(generation.db.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchall(),[('ok',)]);self.assertEqual(generation.db.execute('PRAGMA foreign_key_check').fetchall(),[])
        self.assertEqual(set(DATA_TABLES),{'stream_watermark','content_cache','artifact_revision','artifact_head','typed_relation_projection','contract_binding_projection','reference_resolution','authority_fact_projection','ontology_representation_link','projection_gap'})

        self.success(candidate_call(self.service,self.target,'change.prepare','fixture:prepare'))
        self.success(candidate_call(self.service,self.target,'change.validate','validate:integrated'))
        self.success(call(self.channel.context,'operation.inspect',None,lookup={'operation':'change.prepare','idempotency_key':'fixture:prepare'}))
        self.success(self.refreshing());self.fresh_delivery();r,c=self.opening_success();self.success(self.inspection(r['session_ref']));closed=self.success(self.closing(r));self.assertTrue(closed['discarded_memory'])
        observed={x['reply']['operation'] for x in self.events if x['reply']['kind']=='result'};self.assertEqual(observed,set(LEGACY_SUPPORTED))

def test_24_captured_source_corruption_disposes_on_inspection(self):
        r,c=self.opening_success();resource=self.service.sessions.live[r['session_ref']];resource.note(b'owned-fixture-source-invalidation')
        original=self.view.data['config']['scope_ref'];self.view.data['config']['scope_ref']='project:captured-corruption'
        try:
            # Direct kernel observation bypasses API source-selection policy so the
            # actual selected source guard can invalidate and dispose this resource.
            result=self.service.sessions.inspect(self.inspection(r['session_ref'])['message'],{'ref':'fixture','sha256':'0'*64},self.service.sessions.selected(r['session_ref'])['source_cut'])
            self.assertEqual(result['posture'],'indeterminate');self.assertTrue(resource.closed);self.assertEqual(resource.memory,[])
        finally:self.view.data['config']['scope_ref']=original

        c=self.opening();c['message']['budget']['deadline']=(now()+timedelta(seconds=70)).isoformat();r=self.success(c);self.assertEqual(r['posture'],'active')
        resource=self.service.sessions.live[r['session_ref']];resource.note(b'private-note-expiring-in-real-time');held=resource.memory[0]
        deadline=time.monotonic()+90
        while not resource.closed and time.monotonic()<deadline:time.sleep(0.2)
        self.assertTrue(resource.closed,'real deadline disposal timer did not finish');self.assertEqual(held,bytearray(len(held)))
        self.assertEqual(self.success(self.inspection(r['session_ref']))['posture'],'expired')

def test_actual_original_byte_export(self):
        result = self.host.materialize(self.request)
        self.assertEqual(result['posture'], 'published')
        generation = self.root / sha(encoded(self.request))
        for path, material in zip(self.request['managed_relative_paths'], self.actual, strict=True):
            self.assertEqual((generation / 'files' / path).read_bytes(), material.original_bytes)
        self.assertFalse(result['canonical_replay_source'])
        self.assertEqual(result['authority_effect'], 'none')
        self.observations.append({'request': copy.deepcopy(self.request), 'result': result, 'manifest': json.loads((generation / 'manifest.json').read_bytes()), 'owned_root': str(self.root), 'fixture_permission_only': True})

def test_05_metadata_eight_operation_grant_cannot_export(self):
        call = self.call()
        self.service.close()
        # A metadata grant receives its own fresh workspace. Export generations
        # and directory scope remain protected by the original export grant.
        separate = Path(self.enterContext(tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cal-R03-export-denied-metadata-')))
        separate.chmod(0o700)
        self.key,self.policy,self.pin = MF.provision(separate,{}, {}, scoped=False)
        self.start()
        call['caller_context_ref'] = self.channel.context['context_ref']
        reply = self.invoke(call)
        self.assertEqual(reply['code'], 'unsupported-operation')
        self.assertEqual(list((self.root / 'workspace/journal').glob('*')), [])
        self.assertEqual(list((separate / 'workspace/journal').glob('*')), [])

def test_20_stdio_actual_nonce_and_export(self):
        self.service.close()
        process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,str(HERE/'serve.py'),'--policy',str(self.policy),'--policy-sha256',self.pin,'--source-sha256',SOURCE,'--protocol-profile-sha256',PROFILE], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        try:
            challenge = source.parse(process.stdout.readline())
            process.stdin.write(MF.proof(self.key, challenge) + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            auth = source.parse(process.stdout.readline())
            client = SimpleNamespace(channel=SimpleNamespace(context=auth['context'],policy=source.parse(self.policy.read_bytes())),schemas=self.schemas)
            call = F.call(client,self.selected,key='fixture:stdio-export')
            process.stdin.write(compact(call) + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            reply = source.parse(process.stdout.readline())
            self.assertEqual(reply['kind'], 'result', reply)
            self.assertEqual(reply['message']['posture'], 'published')
            self.events.append({'call': call,'reply':reply,'actual_stdio':True})
            self.public.append({'owned_root':str(self.root),'actual_stdio_challenge':challenge,'authentication_reply':auth,'authority_effect':'none'})
            process.stdin.close()
            code = process.wait(timeout=120)
            self.assertEqual(code,0,process.stderr.read().decode())
        finally:
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.kill()
                process.wait()
            for stream in (process.stdout,process.stderr):
                stream.close()

def test_22_kernel_refuses_root_swap_after_plan(self):
        call = self.call()
        request = call['message']
        materials = []
        with M.model_read_batch(self.view):
            for header in request['artifact_refs']:
                raw,locator,encoding,_ = M.record_bytes(self.view,self.view.subjects[header['version_ref']])
                materials.append(K.Material(compact(header),raw,locator,encoding))
        control = self.channel.policy['export_control']
        selected = K.Selection(request['selection_ref'],compact(request['source_cut']),tuple(materials),self.service.vault.material(control['privacy_review_binding']))
        root = self.output()
        calls = [0]
        def fixture_permission():
            calls[0] += 1
            if calls[0] == 2:
                root.rename(root.with_name('exports-original'))
                root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
            return True
        host = K.ExportHost(root,request['output_root_scope_ref'],request['actor'],selected,self.schemas,self.view.custody_signed_sources.guard,fixture_permission,1048576,control['output_root_identity'])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            host.materialize(request)
        self.assertEqual(list(root.iterdir()),[])
        self.assertTrue((root.with_name('exports-original')/'.scope.json').is_file())

def test_23_busy_quota_lock_retains_pending_key(self):
        descriptor = os.open(self.output()/'.generation.lock',os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
        try:
            fcntl.flock(descriptor,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            call = self.call()
            reply = self.invoke(call)
            self.assertEqual(reply['message']['code'],'recovery-required')
        finally:
            os.close(descriptor)
        query = MF.call(self.channel.context,'operation.inspect',cut(self.view),lookup={'operation':'files.materialize','idempotency_key':'fixture:public-export'})
        result = self.success(query)
        self.assertTrue(result['reconciliation_required'])
        self.assertEqual(result['posture'],'indeterminate')
        call['call_id'] = 'call:lock-retry:'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        reply = self.invoke(call)
        self.assertEqual(reply['message']['code'],'recovery-required')
        self.assertEqual({p.name for p in self.output().iterdir()},{'.scope.json','.generation.lock'})

        self.assertEqual(report['result'],'not-evaluable');self.assertEqual(report['authority_effect'],'none')

def test_all_original_facts_and_witnesses(self):
        with participation_snapshot(self.parent, self.delivery) as snapshot:
            self.assertIs(type(snapshot), self.delivery.EL.ExactSources)
            self.assertEqual(set(snapshot.records), set(self.parent.sources.records))
            for version, original in self.parent.sources.records.items():
                selected, body = snapshot.get(original.artifact)
                self.assertEqual(selected.original, original.original)
                self.assertEqual(selected.revision_witness, original.revision_witness)
                self.assertEqual(selected.artifact, original.artifact)
                self.assertEqual(body, self.delivery.EL.parse(original.original))

def test_02_all_seven_public_read_operations_with_actual_Actor(self):
        context,_=self.authenticated();current=cut(self.view)
        for op in ('lab.status','catalog.get','artifact.query'):
            self.assertEqual(self.machine_call(F.call(context,op,current))['kind'],'result')
        subject=next(s for s in self.view.subjects.values() if s['identity']==self.peer.resource.agent['payload']['profile_ref'].split('@')[0])
        self.assertEqual(self.machine_call(F.call(context,'artifact.inspect',current,artifact=M.artifact_ref(self.view,subject),include=['body','contract','gaps']))['kind'],'result')
        message=D.query(self.view.custody_signed_sources,self.peer.service.sessions.bridge)
        message['budget'].update(max_input_bytes=65536,max_output_bytes=1048576)
        request=F.call(context,'lab.status',current);request.update(operation='context.get',message=message)
        self.assertEqual(self.machine_call(request)['kind'],'result')
        request=self.inspection(context['session_ref'])
        request['caller_context_ref']=context['context_ref']
        request['message']['actor']={k:context[k] for k in ('principal_ref','agent_instance_ref','assignment_ref','session_ref')}
        request['message']['actor']['role_assignment_refs']=[]
        self.assertEqual(self.machine_call(request)['kind'],'result')
        self.assertEqual(self.machine_call(F.call(context,'operation.inspect',None,lookup={'operation':'session.open','idempotency_key':self.opening_call['idempotency_key']}))['kind'],'result')
        self.assertEqual({row['operation'] for row in self.machine_events},set(MT.READ_OPERATIONS))

def test_10_real_policy_revocation_invalidates_credential(self):
        self.authenticated();original=self.policy.read_bytes()
        with self.policy.open('ab') as stream:stream.write(b'\n')
        try:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):self.peer.guard()
            self.assertTrue(self.peer.closed);self.assertIsNone(self.peer._private_key)
        finally:self.policy.write_bytes(original)

def test_deadline_after_evidence_retains_completed_record(self):
        from . import service as module
        original=module.now;actual=self.service.candidates.validate;expired=[False]
        def validated(*args):
            result=actual(*args);expired[0]=True;return result
        c=candidate_call(self.service,self.target,'change.validate','validate:expired-after')
        with patch.object(self.service.candidates,'validate',side_effect=validated),patch.object(module,'now',side_effect=lambda:original()+timedelta(days=1) if expired[0] else original()):
            r=self.service.call(compact(c));self.assertEqual(r['message']['code'],'indeterminate',r)
        i=call(self.channel.context,'operation.inspect',None,lookup={'operation':'change.validate','idempotency_key':'validate:expired-after'})
        self.assertEqual(self.service.call(compact(i))['message']['posture'],'completed')

def test_four_retained_read_handlers_actual(self):
        for op in ('lab.status','catalog.get','artifact.query'):
            r=self.service.call(compact(call(self.channel.context,op,cut(self.view))));self.assertEqual(r['kind'],'result',r)
        from .artifact_model import artifact_ref
        subject=next(s for s in self.view.subjects.values() if s['kind']=='work')
        c=call(self.channel.context,'artifact.inspect',cut(self.view),artifact=artifact_ref(self.view,subject))
        self.assertEqual(self.service.call(compact(c))['kind'],'result')

def test_small_receipt_budget_refused_before_effect(self):
        # The declared outer wire ceiling is >=4096. Below that bound,
        # refusal is a transport error, before a domain result or durable effect.
        # This matches the independently retained CorrectedPreparation case.
        c=candidate_call(self.service,self.target);c['max_response_bytes']=1
        r=self.service.call(compact(c))
        self.assertEqual(r['schema_version'],'lab-api-transport-error/v1-candidate')
        self.assertEqual(r['code'],'invalid-envelope')
        self.assertFalse(list((self.root/'workspace/journal').iterdir()))

def test_small_receipt_budget_refused_before_effect(self):
        # The exact wire contract requires >=4096. A ceiling of 1 is malformed
        # before dispatch; the domain budget gate is never reached.
        c=candidate_call(self.service,self.target);c['max_response_bytes']=1
        with patch.object(self.service.candidates,'prepare',side_effect=AssertionError('must not dispatch')):
            r=self.service.call(compact(c))
        self.assertEqual(r['schema_version'],'lab-api-transport-error/v1-candidate')
        self.assertEqual(r['code'],'invalid-envelope')
        self.assertFalse(list((self.root/'workspace/journal').iterdir()))

        service, request, witness = self.example()
        reply = self.invoke(service, request())
        self.assertEqual(reply['kind'], 'result')
        result = reply['message']

        self.assertEqual(len(manifest['ordered_required_owner_responses']), 2)

        self.assertFalse(manifest['current_owner_authority_verified'])
        self.assertIsNone(manifest['actual_owner_outcome'])
        self.assertEqual(manifest['repository_admissions_applied'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(manifest['runtime_activations'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(manifest['external_effect_refs'], [])
        for row in manifest['targets']:
            body = service.vault.material(row['original_content_binding'])
            self.assertEqual(P.source.sha(body), row['target']['artifact']['byte_sha256'])
            self.assertNotEqual(body, self.view.handle.common.encoded(P.frame_parse(body)))

def test_01_actual_retry_reads_saved_outcome_without_redispatch(self):
        service, request, _ = self.example()
        call = request()
        first = self.invoke(service, call)
        self.assertEqual(first['kind'], 'result')
        before = self.journal(service)
        retry = copy.deepcopy(call)
        retry['call_id'] += ':retry'
        second = self.invoke(service, retry)
        self.assertEqual(second['kind'], 'result')
        self.assertEqual(second['message'], first['message'])
        self.assertEqual(self.journal(service), before)
        inspection = self.inspect(service)
        self.assertEqual(inspection['kind'], 'result')
        self.assertFalse(inspection['message']['retry_allowed'])
        self.assertFalse(inspection['message']['reconciliation_required'])

def test_08_actual_nonce_and_operator_context(self):
        service, _, witness = self.example()
        from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PublicKey
        proof = witness['signed_nonce_proof']
        Ed25519PublicKey.from_public_bytes(base64.b64decode(witness['public_policy']['reader_public_key'])).verify(
            base64.b64decode(proof['signature']), P.compact(proof['challenge']))
        context = service.channel.context
        self.assertEqual(context['role_assignment_bindings'], [])
        self.assertEqual(context['authority_scope'], 'operator-local')
        for key in ['agent_instance_ref', 'session_ref', 'assignment_ref']:
            self.assertIsNone(context[key])
        self.assertFalse(context['accept_client_supplied_authority_context'])
        self.assertNotIn('session.open', service.channel.policy['allowed_operations'])
        self.assertNotIn('admission.apply', service.channel.policy['allowed_operations'])
        self.assertEqual(len(service.channel.policy['allowed_operations']), 9)

def test_01_actual_submit_prepare_review_retry_inspection(self):
        service, proposal, witness = self.submitted()
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(service.vault.manifest)
        inputs = copy.deepcopy(service.vault.inputs)
        reply = self.invoke(service, self.operation(service, 'change.prepare', proposal, 'fixture:composed-prepare'))
        self.assertEqual(reply['kind'], 'result', reply)
        review = reply['message']
        self.assertEqual(len(review['stable_core_bindings']), 5)
        self.assertTrue(review['gaps'])
        call = self.operation(service, 'proposal.review', review, 'fixture:composed-review')
        reply = self.invoke(service, call)
        self.assertEqual(reply['kind'], 'result', reply)
        package = reply['message']
        self.assertEqual(package['human_checkpoint_count'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(package['ordered_core_bindings'], review['stable_core_bindings'])
        self.assertTrue(package['all_targets_materialized'])
        material = P.frame_parse(service.vault.object_read(package['manifest_binding']))
        self.assertEqual(len(material['targets']), 5)
        self.assertEqual(len(material['ordered_required_owner_responses']), 10)
        self.assertEqual(material['original_semantic_and_operational_gaps'], review['gaps'])
        self.assertIsNone(material['actual_owner_outcome'])
        self.assertFalse(material['current_owner_authority_verified'])
        self.assertEqual(material['repository_admissions_applied'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(material['runtime_activations'], 0)
        W.privacy(material)
        before = self.journal(service)
        call['call_id'] += ':retry'
        retry = self.invoke(service, call)
        self.assertEqual(retry['message'], package)
        self.assertEqual(self.journal(service), before)
        inspect = F.call(service.channel.context, 'operation.inspect', H.cut(self.view))
        inspect['deadline'] = service.channel.context['expires_at']
        inspect['message']['lookup'] = {'operation': 'proposal.review', 'idempotency_key': 'fixture:composed-review'}
        self.assertEqual(self.invoke(service, inspect)['kind'], 'result')
        self.assertEqual(service.vault.manifest, manifest)
        self.assertEqual(service.vault.inputs, inputs)
        self.assertEqual(P.compact(self.view.data['projection']), self.projection)

def test_03_changed_member_effect_refused_before_claim(self):
        service, proposal, _ = self.submitted()
        proposal['targets'][-1]['requested_effect'] += ' edited'
        before = self.journal(service)
        reply = self.invoke(service, self.operation(service, 'change.prepare', proposal, 'fixture:alteration'))
        self.assertEqual(reply['kind'], 'error')
        self.assertEqual(reply['message']['code'], 'invalid-contract')
        self.assertEqual(self.journal(service), before)
